description: Look up a canonical AtlaSent concept from the Knowledge Atlas — the compiled graph of the system's own vocabulary (Caller, Authority, Policy, Decision, Permit, Verification, Evidence, Audit Chain, Gate, Trust Root, ...). Returns the concept's canonical definition (its source-of-truth doc), its relationships (what it depends on and what depends on it), the surfaces that realize it, and its ADR / API / SDK / implementation anchors — so every AI host reasons from the same canonical knowledge instead of guessing. Use `id` for an exact concept id (e.g. 'permit', 'audit-chain', 'gate') or `query` for a case-insensitive substring search across id, term, and definition. Omit both to list every concept.

query.description: Substring search across id, term, and definition. Case-insensitive.

name: atlasent_atlas_lookup
title: AtlaSent — Knowledge Atlas Lookup
